item.text: {"summary":"A shrub native to eastern Asia—northeastern China, Japan, Korea and southeastern Siberia—the rugosa rose naturally grows along sandy coasts. It forms dense, prickly thickets and has deeply wrinkled leaves with scented flowers ranging from dark pink to white.
